subject: Scroll bar of selectizeInput does not work on Internet Explorer 10

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Scroll bar of selectizeInput does not work on Internet Explorer 10
parts:
I have a shiny application that uses 
selectizeInput()

in various places. On IE 10 the scoll bar does not work, but you can still use a mouse wheel or the keyboard arrows. This seems to be an issue on older versions of selctize.js that have since been resolved - see here: https://github.com/brianreavis/selectize.js/issues/182. Is shiny using an older version of selectize.js? Should I make this an issue on github?

Thanks
JP

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Scroll bar of selectizeInput does not work on Internet Explorer 10
parts:
Yes, we are still using selectize 0.9.1. It seems we need to upgrade
to 0.10.x now...

Regards,
Yihui
